items.title: 絕無蓋牌！金管會推官方台股儀表板 拚第3季底前上線
items.title_en: No Hidden Cards! Financial Supervisory Commission Pushes Official Taiwan Stock Dashboard, Aiming for Launch Before End of Q3
paras: 台股上月底劇烈修正，一度跌破 4 萬點大關，部分民間平台推估個股維持率引發斷頭恐慌，證交所多次澄清，現行制度是以整戶信用交易部位合併計算，並無單一個股低於 130% 即追繳的機制。金管會今 (4) 日亦強調「沒有蓋牌、只有亮牌」，已責成證交所整合大家最關心的數據，包含融資餘額、整戶擔保維持率等，規劃以「儀表板」方式呈現，預計於第 3 季底前推出，全面提升市場資訊透明度。
針對外界關切信用交易資訊與維持率等議題，證期局副局長黃仲豪指出，金管會對於資本市場的管理立場是「盡量提供正確、完整、即時的資訊給大眾參考」，秉持安全、透明、公平原則。包含信用交易融資餘額、整戶擔保維持率、借券賣出占比等重要數據，將會完整提供給投資人參閱，目前證交所正在研議，努力在今年第 3 季底前上線。
至於是否提供歷史數據回溯，黃仲豪說，將再與交易所評估資料完整性後研商。而民間機構如 CMoney 先前已經下架大盤融資維持率相關資訊，未來要如何發布運算數據，金管會予以尊重。
日前有媒體頻引用民間平台發布的「擔保維持率」，造成投資人誤以為特定個股低於 130% 即將面臨斷頭，證交所多次發布新聞稿澄清，指出現行制度絕不存在「單一個股擔保維持率低於 130% 即代表將遭追繳或斷頭」的機制。
依現行規定，信用交易擔保維持率是以投資人「整戶」部位作為管理基礎，採融資、融券合併計算，並涵蓋投資人持有的所有上市、上櫃信用交易部位及抵繳擔保品。券商辦理追繳或處分 (斷頭)，完全看「整戶維持率」是否達標，而非看單一個股。
民間平台因無法掌握投資人整戶的實際持股、融資券組合及其他抵繳擔保品等完整資訊，其推估之「個股維持率」無法反映真實信用風險。若投資人以此進行買賣決策，恐因誤判市場風險而增加自身損失，甚至造成個股價格不必要的過度波動。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks underwent a sharp correction at the end of last month, briefly falling below the 40,000-point mark. Some private platforms estimated individual stock maintenance ratios, sparking panic about margin calls. The Taiwan Stock Exchange repeatedly clarified that the current system calculates margin positions on a whole‑account basis, and there is no mechanism that triggers a call when a single stock falls below 130%. On the 4th, the Financial Supervisory Commission also emphasized "no hidden cards, only open cards" and tasked the exchange with integrating the data most investors care about—such as financing balances and whole‑account maintenance ratios—into a "dashboard" format, expected to be released before the end of the third quarter, thereby enhancing market information transparency.

Regarding public concerns about credit‑trading information and maintenance ratios, Deputy Director of the Securities and Futures Bureau Huang Zhong‑hao said the FSC’s stance on capital‑market oversight is to "provide the public with accurate, complete, and timely information" while upholding safety, transparency, and fairness. Important data—including credit‑trading financing balances, whole‑account maintenance ratios, and the proportion of securities borrowed for short selling—will be fully disclosed to investors. The exchange is currently studying the implementation and aims to go live before the end of Q3 this year.

As for whether historical data will be made available for back‑testing, Huang said this will be examined with the exchange after assessing data completeness. Private firms such as CMoney have already removed market‑wide financing‑maintenance‑ratio information; how they will publish calculated data in the future will be respected by the FSC.

Recently, media outlets repeatedly cited "maintenance ratios" released by private platforms, leading investors to mistakenly believe that a specific stock falling below 130% would face an imminent margin call. The exchange has issued multiple press releases to clarify that the current system does not contain any mechanism whereby a "single‑stock maintenance ratio below 130%" triggers a call or forced liquidation.

Under existing regulations, the credit‑trading maintenance ratio is based on the investor’s "whole‑account" position, combining financing and securities‑lending balances and covering all listed and over‑the‑counter credit‑trading positions as well as collateral. Brokers’ decisions to issue margin calls or enforce liquidations depend entirely on whether the whole‑account maintenance ratio meets the required level, not on any individual stock.

Because private platforms cannot access an investor’s complete holdings, financing‑securities portfolio, and other collateral, their estimated "stock‑specific maintenance ratios" do not reflect the true credit risk. If investors base trading decisions on these figures, they may misjudge market risk, increase their own losses, and even cause unnecessary price volatility in the affected stocks.

items.title: 鮮活果汁-KY迎旺季 7月營收年月雙增 累計1-7月創同期新高
items.title_en: Fresh Juice - KY Enters Peak Season, July Revenue Grows Both Month-over-Month and Year-over-Year, Cumulative Jan‑July Hits Record High
paras: 鮮活果汁 - KY(1256-TW) 今 (4) 日公布最新營收資訊，2026 年 7 月營收幣 6.19 億元，月成長 7.6%、年增 21.99%，累計 2026 年 1-7 月營收 32.67 億元，年增 41.87%。主要受惠中國新茶飲市場進入夏季消費旺季。鮮活的昆山新廠預計近期投入營運，將進一步提升整體供貨能力。
同時，鮮活果汁 - KY 指出，品牌客戶拉貨需求持續升溫，加上公司持續深化產品布局及提升供應能力，帶動 7 月營收繳出年月雙增佳績。
鮮活果汁 - KY 係因適逢暑期消費旺季來臨，各大新茶飲品牌持續推出季節限定飲品及水果茶新品，帶動果汁、風味飲品等原料需求穩定成長，公司憑藉完整的產品研發實力、供應鏈整合能力及長期深耕客戶基礎，持續掌握市場商機，推升整體接單及出貨動能。同時公司持續優化產品組合，提升高附加價值產品比重，為整體營運成長增添動能，累計 1-7 月營收 32.67 億元，創歷年同期新高。
為因應直飲產品市場快速發展，鮮活果汁 - KY 昆山新廠預計近期投入營運，進一步提升整體供貨能力。新廠亦持續擴充直飲產品產能，助力直飲產品業務成長，並整合 MES 製造執行系統及 WMS 倉儲管理系統，建構具高度彈性的智慧生產模式，可依市場需求快速調整產線配置，兼顧客製化小量訂單與大規模量產需求，不僅提升人均產值與生產效率，更進一步鞏固鮮活於中國大陸新茶飲供應鏈的競爭優勢。
paras_en: Fresh Juice - KY (1256‑TW) announced today (the 4th) its latest revenue figures: July 2026 revenue was NT$619 million, up 7.6% month‑over‑month and 21.99% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑July 2026 reached NT$3.267 billion, a 41.87% increase year‑over‑year. The growth was mainly driven by the Chinese new‑tea‑drink market entering its summer consumption peak. Fresh Juice’s new plant in Kunshan is expected to start operations soon, further boosting overall supply capacity.

At the same time, Fresh Juice - KY noted that brand customers’ pull‑forward ordering demand continues to heat up, and the company’s ongoing deepening of product placement and supply capability helped deliver the strong double‑digit growth in July.

The summer consumption peak has prompted major new‑tea‑drink brands to launch seasonal limited‑edition drinks and new fruit‑tea products, driving steady growth in demand for juice, flavored beverages and other raw materials. Leveraging its comprehensive product R&D strength, supply‑chain integration capability, and long‑standing customer relationships, the company continues to capture market opportunities, boosting overall order intake and shipment momentum. The firm also keeps optimizing its product mix to increase the proportion of high‑value‑added items, adding further momentum to overall operational growth. Cumulative Jan‑July revenue of NT$3.267 billion set a new high for the same period in company history.

To meet the rapid development of the ready‑to‑drink product market, Fresh Juice - KY’s new Kunshan plant is slated to commence operations soon, further enhancing overall supply capacity. The new facility is also expanding ready‑to‑drink production capacity to support business growth, and is integrating a MES manufacturing execution system and a WMS warehouse management system to build a highly flexible smart manufacturing model. This allows quick adjustments of production lines according to market demand, accommodating both small‑batch customized orders and large‑scale mass production. The upgrades not only raise per‑employee output and production efficiency but also further solidify Fresh Juice’s competitive advantage in China’s new‑tea‑drink supply chain.

items.title: 防範信用過度擴張！金管會10月起逐月掌握「個人理財周轉金」
items.title_en: Preventing Over-Expansion of Credit! FSC to Monitor Personal Financial Turnover Funds Monthly Starting October
paras: 近年台股交投熱絡，甚至出現「四貸同堂」現象，許多投資人靈活運用信貸、房貸、車貸及股票質押等多重管道籌措資金，放大投資槓桿，日前央行也發聲示警。金管會今 (4) 日表示，已要求國銀於 10 月起申報個人理財周轉金數字，藉由滾動監控資金脈絡，防範過度擴張信用所引發的系統性金融風險。
為了釐清個人借貸周轉金中究竟有多少資金流入股票、基金等金融商品，目前銀行向中央銀行申報的資料中，已有「投資股票等金融商品的理財周轉金貸款」這項數據，但銀行向金管會申報資料中尚無。
金管會銀行局副局長王允中表示，過去銀行申報周轉金多將企業與個人混合計算，且以擔保品分類，缺乏單純針對「個人理財用途」的統計。為此，金管會已要求本國銀行新增申報「個人理財周轉金」項目。
王允中說明，銀行僅需向金管會申報一個「總金額」數字，不需分項列出。資金須為個人借款，且客戶向銀行明確表明或勾選用途為「投資理財」，意指廣泛的金融商品，包括股票、基金、債券、投資型保單及衍生性商品等。
涵蓋業務包括：理財型房貸、房貸增貸 (非用於購屋者)、股票質押 / 有價證券擔保貸款、個人信用貸款，以及少數其他周轉金 (如獨資合夥企業主營運周轉金或員工認購自家股票專案貸款)。
配合銀行端系統調整，本國銀行將於 10 月份正式開始申報 9 月份的資料，作為金管會進行持續性風險控管的依據。
paras_en: In recent years, the Taiwan stock market has been hot, with the phenomenon of 'four loans in one room' emerging. Many investors have been using multiple channels such as credit, mortgage, car loan, and stock pledge to raise funds, thereby amplifying their investment leverage. The central bank has recently issued a warning. The FSC announced today (4th) that it has asked domestic banks to report personal financial turnover funds starting from October, using rolling monitoring to prevent systemic financial risks triggered by excessive credit expansion.

To clarify how much of the personal loan turnover funds have flowed into stocks, funds, and other financial products, the current bank data submitted to the central bank already includes the data item 'investment in stocks and other financial products through financial turnover loans', but there is no such data item in the data submitted to the FSC.

FSC Banking Bureau Deputy Director Wang Yunzhong pointed out that in the past, banks have reported turnover funds by mixing corporate and personal data, and classified by collateral, lacking a simple statistical approach to 'personal financial purposes'. Therefore, the FSC has asked domestic banks to add a new reporting item 'personal financial turnover funds'.

Wang Yunzhong explained that banks only need to report a 'total amount' number to the FSC, without breaking it down into individual items. The funds must be personal loans, and the customer must explicitly indicate or tick the purpose as 'investment and finance', meaning a wide range of financial products, including stocks, funds, bonds, investment-type insurance, and derivative products.

The scope of business includes: financial-type mortgage loans, mortgage refinancing (not for purchasing a house), stock pledge / securities collateral loans, personal credit loans, and a few other turnover funds (such as sole proprietorship business owner's operating turnover funds or employee stock purchase project loans).

In conjunction with the adjustment of the bank's system, domestic banks will officially start reporting data for September in October, serving as the basis for the FSC to conduct ongoing risk management.

items.title: 日元空頭部位逼近2024年高點！套利交易捲土重來  逆轉風險將有多大？
items.title_en: Yen Shorts Approach 2024 High as Carry Trades Make a Comeback
paras: 今年以來，隨著日元持續疲弱、美日利差再度走闊，「借日元買美元資產」的套利交易規模明顯回潮，日本離岸金融帳戶淨資產截至5月突破2024年底高點、攀至95兆日元。
根據芝商所(CME)數據顯示，日元兌美元非商業淨空頭部位上月底大約15萬口合約，達2024年7月高點八成以上，擁擠度直逼兩年前引發全球股災的極端水位。
日本日前聯手美國介入匯市，估算投入約8.45兆日元(逾500億美元)，推升美元兌日元匯率自163高點回落至157附近，空頭遭重挫但未瓦解。
目前，市場關切2024年8月式的套利崩盤會否重演，主流機構判斷短期逆轉機率偏低，但部位過度集中下的「觸發式平倉」仍是今年下半年全球資本市場最大的尾部風險。

專家認為，三大邏輯支撐著「低逆轉風險」。一，宏觀環境不同於2024年8月(當時美非農驟冷、降息預期飆升)；當前美國經濟維持韌性，油價二次反彈拖慢通膨回落。聯準會(Fed)上周三(7月29日)以9比3維持利率於3.5%—3.75%不變、內部鷹派聲浪未消，美元與美債長端殖利率易強難弱，套利利差(美日約250—275bp)仍具吸引力；二，本輪科技股回檔屬漲多估值消化與部位再平衡，非AI敘事證偽或美國基本面轉壞，風險偏好未劇烈扭轉，暫不構成集中平倉壓力；三，日元疲軟主因並非純套利，而是日本財政擴張加劇債務可續疑慮、市場質疑日本央行(BOJ)獨立性，加上中東油價透過能源進口成本打擊日本貿易條件，結構性貶值動能獨立於套利交易之外。
然而「低機率」不等於「無衝擊」。BOJ上周五(7月31日)維持1%利率不變，總裁植田和男坦言通膨超標風險上升、匯率傳導增強，年內再升息一次已成基準情景，歐洲央行(ECB)上月也按兵不動，但9月升息懸念未解，英國央行也6比3鷹派僵持。
專家指出，一旦後續出現三大觸發點，美國經濟數據超預期走弱帶崩美債殖利率、AI族群深跌推高波動、日本財務省二度大手筆干預，高度擁擠的空頭恐瞬間反向踩踏，重演2024年8月式跨市場連鎖去槓桿。
地緣政治層面，美伊圍繞荷姆茲海峽反覆衝突，該水路牽動日本90%以上原油進口，任何通行風險都經「油價→通膨→美債利率→日元」路徑放大波動。
綜合來看，套利交易當下處於「收益尚可、部位危險」狀態。投資人短期無須恐慌性平倉，但須把美國經濟拐點、BOJ升息節奏、荷姆茲海峽局勢列為三盞紅燈，畢竟空頭部位已回到歷史高點附近。
paras_en: Since the beginning of the year, the yen has continued to weaken, and the US-Japan interest rate differential has widened again, leading to a significant rebound in carry trade volumes, with Japanese offshore financial accounts' net assets reaching a record high of 95 trillion yen as of May, surpassing the 2024 year-end high.

According to data from the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME), the non-commercial net short yen position at the end of last month was approximately 150,000 contracts, exceeding 80% of the July 2024 high, with the crowdedness approaching the extreme levels that triggered the global stock market crash two years ago.

Japan recently intervened in the foreign exchange market in conjunction with the US, estimated to have injected around 8.45 trillion yen (over $500 billion), pushing the US dollar-yen exchange rate from 163 to around 157, causing significant losses for shorts but not eliminating them.

The market is currently concerned about the possibility of a repeat of the August 2024 carry trade collapse, with mainstream institutions judging the short-term reversal probability to be low, but the 'trigger-style liquidation' of over-concentrated positions remains the largest tail risk in global capital markets for the second half of the year.

Experts believe that three major logical supports the 'low reversal risk'. First, the macro environment is different from August 2024 (when US non-farm payrolls suddenly cooled and interest rate expectations soared); currently, the US economy maintains its resilience, and the second round of oil price rebound slows down the decline in inflation. The Federal Reserve (Fed) maintained its interest rate at 3.5% to 3.75% last Wednesday (July 29) with a 9-3 vote, and the internal hawkish voices have not dissipated, making the dollar and long-term US Treasury yields strong and weak, respectively, and the carry trade spread (around 250-275bp) remains attractive.

Second, this round of tech stock decline is a digestion of overvaluation and rebalancing of positions, and non-AI narrative evidence or a deterioration in US fundamentals have not caused a significant shift in risk appetite, and there is no pressure for concentrated liquidation.

Third, the yen's weakness is not solely due to carry trade, but rather the Japanese government's expansion of fiscal spending, which has exacerbated debt sustainability concerns, and the market's doubts about the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) independence, as well as the impact of Middle East oil prices on Japan's trade conditions through energy import costs, making structural depreciation independent of carry trade.

However, 'low probability' does not mean 'no impact'. The BOJ maintained its 1% interest rate unchanged last Friday (July 31), with Governor Kazuo Ueda acknowledging the rising risk of inflation exceeding the target, and the exchange rate transmission increasing, making a rate hike in the year a baseline scenario, with the European Central Bank (ECB) also maintaining its stance, but the 9% rate hike expectation in September remains, and the Bank of England also had a 6-3 hawkish stalemate.

Experts point out that if the three trigger points appear, the US economic data will unexpectedly weaken, triggering a collapse in US Treasury yields, AI stocks will plummet, and the Japanese Ministry of Finance will intervene again, the highly crowded short positions will be suddenly trampled, and the August 2024-style cross-market chain reaction will be repeated.

From a geopolitical perspective, the US-Iran conflict surrounding the Hormuz Strait has repeatedly escalated, with the waterway affecting 90% of Japan's oil imports, and any passage risk will be amplified through the 'oil price -> inflation -> US Treasury yields -> yen' channel.

In summary, the carry trade is currently in a state of 'profits are still available, but positions are risky'. Investors do not need to panic liquidate in the short term, but they should pay attention to the US economic turning point, the BOJ's rate hike pace, and the Hormuz Strait situation, as the short positions have returned to historical highs.

items.title: 【達方法說會AI摘要】2026/8/4
items.title_en: Dahua Technology Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
paras:
一、 達方 (8163-TW) 2026 年第二季財務與營運詳情

財務表現：

• 營收與獲利： 2026 年第二季合併營收達新臺幣 75.17 億元，季增 24.8%、年增 8.9%。營業毛利為 12.46 億元（季增 15.1%、年增 12.1%），營業毛利率微幅下滑至 16.6%。營業利益回升至 4.18 億元，營業利益率約 5.5%。歸屬於母公司股東淨利為 8.6 億元（季增 51.6%、年增 47%），單季基本每股盈餘（EPS）為 NT$0.31 元。
• 上半年累積： 2026 上半年合併營收為 NT$135.42 億元，年增 9.32%；營業毛利率約 17.2%（年增 11.5%）；營業淨利為 2.27 億元（年增 42.8%）；歸屬母公司淨利為 1.43 億元（年增 19%），上半年 EPS 為 NT$0.51 元。
• 資產與現金流： 截至第二季底，現金及約當現金接近 60.8 億元，資產總計 345 億元，每股淨值為 NT$38.4 元。上半年資本支出約 5 億元（70% 用於自動化設備與生產模具，30% 用於越南新廠擴建），併購海昌支出約 3.8 億元。

三大事業群營收結構：

• 綠能產品（Green Energy）： 2Q 營收佔比升至 45%（上半年平均為 42%），主因歐洲綠能通路業務大幅回升及 E-bike 成長帶動。
• IT 周邊產品（IT Peripherals）： 2Q 營收佔比降至 43%（上半年平均為 46%），營收雖呈季成長，但增幅低於綠能事業。
• 整合元件（Integrated Components）： 2Q 及上半年營收佔比均維持在 12% 左右，維持雙位數季增長。

市場展望與營運策略：

• 下半年營收展望： 對整體下半年營運持樂觀態度，全年營收預期目標不變。綠能與非綠能（IT 周邊 + 整合元件 + AIoT）營收比重預計維持在約 42：58 的大方向。
• 被動元件（MLCC）供需： 由於日韓廠商將產能轉向 AI 伺服器的高階需求，導致部分高階產品緊缺、交期拉長。公司目前產能利用率極高，去年定案購置的新設備已於今年 8~9 月陸續投入增產高壓、高容等特規品，價格調漲趨勢仍在進行中。
• 綠能庫存去化與轉型： E-bike 庫存處理預計於今年年底告一段落，明年庫存壓力將回歸健康狀態。同時，電池產品逐步從輕型 Mobility/E-bike 延伸至工業用、機器人、無人機，長遠目標亦包含規劃進入 Data Center 領域的 BBU（備援電池單元）。
• 併購布局與 AIoT 轉型： 併購海昌（High-Tide，電源）與佺璟（散熱），結合達方自身的電池技術，構築「散熱 + 電源 + 電池」三合一戰略，鎖定 AI Data Center 與 Server 邊緣端（Edge）切入需求。

【達方法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)】

Q1：被動元件（MLCC）的產能利用率為何？是否有擴產計畫？

回答： 目前被動元件產能利用率相當高，處於供不應求狀態。過去產能規模約在 5 到 10 B 左右（視規格而定）。去年已預先購置新設備，剛好用於今年下半年的增產計畫。未來是否繼續大幅擴產將視明年市場景氣延續狀況而定。

Q2：資本支出（CapEx）中 70% 自動化與 30% 越南擴產的具體細節為何？

回答： 70% 生產設備投資包含：IT 周邊在越南新廠的自動化建設、MLCC 生產設備投入，以及電池業務的設備投資。30% 廠房資本支出主要是子公司泰宇科技在南越規劃建設的新廠房。

Q3：綠能產品在非 E-bike 部分是否轉向 BBU？未來的產品提升規劃？

回答： BBU 針對 Data Center 與 Server，對安規與耐用度（高壓如 800V）要求極高，需要長期驗證。公司近 1~2 年的規劃會優先提升 Mobility（包含工業用、機器人、無人機）的 Non-bike 比重，長期則將 BBU 等大顆電池視為發展目標之一。

Q4：綠能產品（E-bike）的庫存去化進度與訂單能見度為何？

回答： 公司持續清理庫存，希望整體 Mobility（含整車與原物料庫存）能於今年年底告一段落，使明年恢復健康狀態。市場競爭方面，1,000 美元以下低階市場競爭激烈，高價位市場仍有需求；達方的製造（太宇、永捷）與電池業務正加速轉型及調整產品策略。

Q5：公司下半年的毛利率展望為何？

回答： 上半年毛利率約落在 16~17% 之間（2Q 為 16.6%），主因原物料漲價未能完全轉嫁。下半年將透過場區（Site）精實整併、適時反映成本給客戶，加上高毛利周邊產品與綠能庫存去化回升，目標是將毛利率維持在 18% 以上，並持續往 20% 目標邁進。

Q6：今年 2 月併購海昌與佺璟的戰略與效益為何？

回答： 兩家公司分別做電源與散熱，結合達方既有的電池產品，形成「散熱 + 電源 + 電池」三大 AI Data Center 與 Server 的核心要素。目前正從 Edge 端與 Low-end 客戶切入，協助達方的周邊與元件事業向 AIoT 及 AI 應用領域擴展轉型。

Q7：MLCC 特規品的價格趨勢與變動狀況為何？

回答： 因日系廠商產能移往 Data Center，高階高容產品交期拉長且供需尚未平衡。達方的新設備於 8、9 月投入後將增加高壓、高容產能；價格調漲屬於進行式，下半年預計維持此一趨勢。
paras_en: Dahua Technology (8163-TW) reported its second quarter 2026 financial results, with consolidated revenue reaching NT$75.17 billion, a 24.8% increase from the previous quarter and an 8.9% increase from the same period last year.

Gross profit was NT$12.46 billion, a 15.1% increase from the previous quarter and a 12.1% increase from the same period last year, with a gross margin of 16.6%. Operating income rose to NT$4.18 billion, with an operating margin of approximately 5.5%. Net income attributable to shareholders was NT$8.6 billion, a 51.6% increase from the previous quarter and a 47% increase from the same period last year, with a basic earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.31.

For the first half of 2026, consolidated revenue was NT$135.42 billion, a 9.32% increase from the same period last year. Gross margin was approximately 17.2% (a 11.5% increase from the same period last year), with operating net income of NT$2.27 billion (a 42.8% increase from the same period last year) and net income attributable to shareholders of NT$1.43 billion (a 19% increase from the same period last year), with a first-half EPS of NT$0.51.

As of the end of the second quarter, cash and cash equivalents were approximately NT$60.8 billion, with total assets of NT$345 billion and a net asset value per share of NT$38.4. Capital expenditures for the first half were approximately NT$5 billion (70% for automation equipment and production molds, and 30% for the expansion of the new factory in Vietnam), with merger and acquisition expenses of approximately NT$3.8 billion.
The three major business groups' revenue structure:
• Green Energy: 2Q revenue accounted for 45% (average 42% for the first half), mainly due to a significant increase in European green energy channel business and the growth of E-bike sales.
• IT Peripherals: 2Q revenue accounted for 43% (average 46% for the first half), with revenue growth in the quarter, but lower than the growth of the Green Energy business.
• Integrated Components: 2Q and first-half revenue accounted for approximately 12% each, maintaining double-digit quarterly growth.
Market outlook and operating strategy:

• Downstream revenue outlook: The company is optimistic about the overall downstream operation in the second half, with the annual revenue target unchanged. The revenue ratio of Green Energy to non-Green Energy (IT peripherals + Integrated Components + AIoT) is expected to remain around 42:58.

• Passive components (MLCC) supply and demand: Due to the shift of production capacity from Japanese and Korean companies to high-end AI server demand, there is a shortage of high-end products, leading to longer delivery times. The company's current production capacity utilization is extremely high, with new equipment purchased last year to be put into production in August and September, and the price increase trend is expected to continue in the second half.

• Green energy inventory clearing and transformation: The company expects to clear E-bike inventory by the end of this year, with a healthy inventory situation expected next year. At the same time, the company is gradually extending its battery products from lightweight mobility/E-bike to industrial use, robots, and drones, with a long-term goal of entering the data center market with BBU (backup battery unit).

• M&A layout and AIoT transformation: The company has acquired High-Tide (power) and Shangjin (heat dissipation), combining its own battery technology to form a "heat dissipation + power + battery" three-in-one strategy, targeting AI data center and server edge entry demand.
Q&A:
Q1: What is the production capacity utilization rate of passive components (MLCC)? Is there a plan to expand production?

A1: The current production capacity utilization rate of passive components is extremely high, with a supply and demand imbalance. Last year, new equipment was purchased to be put into production in the second half of this year. Whether to continue to expand production will depend on the market situation next year.
Q2: What are the specific details of the capital expenditures (CapEx) of NT$5 billion, with 70% for automation and 30% for Vietnam expansion?

A2: The 70% investment in production equipment includes: automation construction in the new factory in Vietnam, MLCC production equipment, and equipment investment in battery business. The 30% capital expenditure is mainly for the construction of a new factory in Vietnam by a subsidiary.
Q3: Will the Green Energy business shift to BBU in the non-E-bike segment? What are the plans for product upgrades?

A3: BBU is a high-end product with high reliability and durability requirements, which needs long-term verification. The company's plans for the next 1-2 years will focus on upgrading mobility (including industrial use, robots, and drones) in the non-bike segment, with BBU as a long-term development goal.
Q4: What is the progress of clearing E-bike inventory and the visibility of orders?

A4: The company is continuously clearing inventory, aiming to complete the clearing of mobility (including vehicle and raw material inventory) by the end of this year, with a healthy inventory situation expected next year. In terms of market competition, the low-end market below $1,000 is highly competitive, while the high-end market still has demand; the company's manufacturing (Taoyu and Yongjie) and battery business are accelerating transformation and adjusting product strategies.
Q5: What is the company's revenue growth target for the second half?

A5: The gross margin for the first half was approximately 16-17% (2Q was 16.6%), mainly due to the inability to fully pass on the increase in raw materials. In the second half, the company will implement site consolidation, reflect costs to customers in a timely manner, and add high-margin peripherals and green energy inventory clearing, aiming to maintain a gross margin of 18% or higher and continue to move towards a 20% target.
Q6: What is the strategy and benefit of the acquisition of High-Tide and Shangjin in February this year?

A6: The two companies specialize in power and heat dissipation, respectively, combining with Dahua's existing battery products to form a "heat dissipation + power + battery" three-core strategy for AI data center and server edge entry. Currently, the company is cutting into the edge and low-end customer markets, helping Dahua's peripherals and component businesses to transform and expand into AIoT and AI applications.
Q7: What is the trend and variation of the price of MLCC special products?

A7: Due to the shift of production capacity from Japanese and Korean companies to high-end AI server demand, there is a shortage of high-end products, leading to longer delivery times. Dahua's new equipment will be put into production in August and September, increasing high-pressure and high-capacity production capacity; the price increase trend is expected to continue in the second half.

items.title: 2026台日經貿論壇 工商協進會：雙方互補產業優勢共創區域繁榮韌性
items.title_en: 2026 Taiwan-Japan Economic Forum: Bilateral Cooperation to Create Regional Resilience
paras: 為深化台日經貿夥伴關係，促進雙方產業交流與供應鏈合作，工商協進會與日本「中部經濟連合會」於今 (4) 日下午在台北國際會議中心共同舉辦「2026 台日經貿論壇」。工商協進會副理事長黃教漳表示，台日雙方擁高度互補的產業優勢，未來若能結合雙方的技術、人才與市場資源，不僅能創造更多商業契機，更能共同提升亞洲供應鏈韌性，為區域經濟注入強勁的成長動能。
本次論壇聚焦「智慧移動」與「防災應變」兩大核心議題，廣邀台日產官學界要員深度對談，包括面對 AI、數位轉型、綠色轉型快速發展，以及全球供應鏈重組與地緣政治變化加速的國際情勢。
黃教漳致詞時，首先代表工商協進會全體會員，就日前熊本地震災情向中經連會長勝野哲表達誠摯關懷與慰問，也表示去 (2025) 年理事長吳東亮率團訪問日本中部地區考察後，本次勝野會長率團回訪台灣，不僅象徵雙方交流邁入新里程碑，更展現持續深化合作、共創區域繁榮的堅定決心。
勝野哲則表示，日本中部地區身為日本製造業重鎮，目前正積極推動「中部圈願景」。期盼藉由此次訪台考察，深化對台灣半導體與高科技產業、產官學合作模式，以及防災應變經驗的了解，並將相關成果應用於日本中部地區，進一步提升製造業競爭力與區域韌性。
勝野會長補充，未來將持續推動人員往來與民間經濟交流，透過跨國界與跨領域的人才合作，共同因應國際能源波動與經濟不確定性的挑戰。同時，也期待台灣與日本中部企業持續建立更緊密的夥伴關係，共同為全球經濟發展貢獻力量。
本次論壇首先由台日雙方代表各自簡介兩會的會務發展與核心業務現況，說明雙方在促進企業交流、推動區域治理及產業升級上的努力與成果，進一步增進產官學各界對兩會運作機制與合作資源的瞭解。
在完成會務簡介後，論壇隨即展開兩大專業主題的深度交流。在「智慧移動」領域，由車王電 (1533-TW) 集團華德動能 (2237-TW) 科技總經理楊誌榮，分享電動巴士與智慧交通的創新實踐與應用，並由中經連擔當部長和田耕一朗，介紹日本中部推動智慧移動與區域發展的最新實績。
在「防災應變」領域，則由全家 (5903-TW) 便利商店會員數據創研部部長黃士杰分享企業防災與數據應用的實務經驗，並由中經連常務理事事務局長梅村理史分享日本中部地區在災害應變與區域韌性建構的精闢觀點，透過台日雙方企業與專家的經驗碰撞，現場激盪出許多創新思維，不僅促進產業合作新模式也產出豐碩的交流成果。
paras_en: To deepen Taiwan-Japan economic partnership and promote industry exchange and supply chain cooperation, the Taiwan Businessmen's Association and Japan's Central Economic Federation held the 2026 Taiwan-Japan Economic Forum at the Taipei International Convention Center on April 4. Taiwan Businessmen's Association Vice Chairman Huang Jiaozhang said that Taiwan and Japan have highly complementary industry advantages. If they can combine their technologies, talents, and market resources, they can not only create more business opportunities but also enhance the resilience of the Asian supply chain and inject strong growth momentum into regional economies.

The forum focused on two core issues: 'Intelligent Mobility' and 'Disaster Response'. It invited Taiwan and Japan's officials, scholars, and industry leaders to have in-depth discussions, including the rapid development of AI, digital transformation, green transformation, and the reorganization of global supply chains and the acceleration of geopolitical changes.

Huang Jiaozhang spoke on behalf of the Taiwan Businessmen's Association, expressing sincere condolences and sympathy to Central Economic Federation Chairman Shigenobu Katsuno over the recent Kumamoto earthquake disaster. He also mentioned that the association's chairman, Wu Dongliang, led a delegation to visit Japan's central region in 2025 and that this visit by Chairman Katsuno's delegation to Taiwan represents a new milestone in bilateral exchanges and demonstrates their determination to deepen cooperation and create regional prosperity.

Katsuno said that Japan's central region is the country's manufacturing hub and is actively promoting the 'Central Region Vision'. He hopes to deepen their understanding of Taiwan's semiconductor and high-tech industries, as well as their cooperation models and disaster response experiences through this visit, and apply the results to Japan's central region to further enhance its manufacturing competitiveness and regional resilience.

Katsuno added that they will continue to promote personnel exchanges and private economic cooperation, leveraging cross-border and cross-disciplinary talent cooperation to respond to international energy fluctuations and economic uncertainties. They also expect Taiwan and Japan's central region companies to establish closer partnerships and contribute to global economic development.

The forum first had representatives from both sides introduce their respective organizations' development and core business situations, explaining their efforts and achievements in promoting enterprise exchanges, driving regional governance, and upgrading industries, and further increasing the understanding of the operation mechanisms and cooperation resources of both organizations among officials, scholars, and industry leaders.

After completing the introduction of their work, the forum proceeded with in-depth discussions on two professional topics. In the 'Intelligent Mobility' field, Wangde Dynamic Technology General Manager Yang Zhirong shared his innovative practices and applications of electric buses and intelligent transportation, while Central Economic Federation Director and Department Head Ando Kojiro introduced the latest achievements of Japan's central region in promoting intelligent mobility and regional development.

In the 'Disaster Response' field, FamilyMart Data Research Department Director Huang Shijie shared his practical experiences in enterprise disaster response and data applications, while Central Economic Federation General Affairs Director and Bureau Chief Meimura Risuke shared his insightful views on disaster response and regional resilience construction in Japan's central region. Through the collision of experiences between Taiwan and Japan's enterprises and experts, the forum sparked many innovative ideas, not only promoting new industry cooperation models but also producing rich exchange results.

items.title: 幸運兒是你嗎？花10元UberEats爽中1千萬！5-6月統一發票18人秒變千萬富翁
items.title_en: Are You the Lucky One? 18 People Win NT$10 Million with UberEats Orders
paras: 財政部賦稅署公布今 (4) 日 115 年 5-6 月期統一發票中獎清冊，本期特別獎（1000 萬元）共開出 18 張，特獎（200 萬元）開出 22 張。其中最幸運的得主僅花費 10 元外送費購買 Uber Eats 就喜中千萬大獎；此外，跨境電商與數位訂閱服務如 OpenAI、Coupang 及 Google Play 也紛紛開出千萬大獎，引發網友熱議。

本期統一發票特別獎獎金 1000 萬元中獎號碼為「38548029」，特獎獎金 200 萬元號碼為「10138845」。財政部賦稅署指出，排除作廢、買受人為營業人等不符給獎規定發票後，可兌領特別獎與特獎發票分別為 18 張及 22 張。在千萬特別獎部分，消費金額最低的是在新北市林口區優食台灣（Uber Eats）開出的 10 元外送費發票；萊爾富新北石門阿里荖店開出 49 元食品發票；高雄中油加油站也開出 60 元汽油發票，小額消費幸運變身千萬富翁。
值得注意的是，隨著民眾消費習慣改變，本期雲端發票及跨境電商中獎表現亮眼。OpenAI 訂閱費 690 元、Coupang 購物 241 元、Google Play 應用程式 620 元以及台灣大哥大、中華電信等電信月租費，皆開出千萬特別獎，顯示雲端發票中獎機率大幅躍升。
財政部提醒，本期中獎發票領獎期間為 115 年 8 月 6 日至 115 年 11 月 5 日止。民眾若使用載具儲存雲端發票，且未印出電子發票證明聯者，除了能對統一發票號碼，還享有雲端發票專屬獎雙重對獎機會。若於 115 年 7 月 24 日前完成手機條碼歸戶並設定自動匯款帳戶，1000 萬元等獎金將自 8 月 6 日起自動匯入指定帳戶，還可免繳印花稅，既便利又省錢。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance's Taxation Bureau announced the winners of the 115th month's unified invoice lottery on April 4. This period, 18 special prizes (NT$10 million) and 22 special prizes (NT$2 million) were drawn. Among them, the most fortunate winner only spent NT$10 on UberEats delivery fees to win the NT$10 million prize; other cross-border e-commerce and digital subscription services such as OpenAI, Coupang, and Google Play also drew NT$10 million prizes, sparking online discussions.

The special prize winning number for NT$10 million is 38548029, and the special prize winning number for NT$2 million is 10138845. The Ministry of Finance's Taxation Bureau pointed out that after excluding invalid and non-entitled invoices, there are 18 special prizes and 22 special prizes that can be redeemed. In the NT$10 million special prize category, the lowest consumption amount is NT$10 for UberEats delivery fees in New Taipei City's Lin Kou District; a 49 yuan food invoice was also drawn from the Leiyifu store in Shimen, New Taipei City, and a 60 yuan gasoline invoice was drawn from a gas station in Kaohsiung.

It's worth noting that with the changing consumer habits of the public, this period's cloud invoices and cross-border e-commerce have shown outstanding performance. OpenAI's subscription fee of NT$6,900, Coupang's purchase of NT$2,410, Google Play's application fee of NT$6,200, and Taiwan's telecom companies' monthly fees, all drew NT$10 million special prizes, showing that the probability of winning cloud invoices has increased significantly.

The Ministry of Finance reminds that the redemption period for winning invoices is from August 6 to November 5, 115. If citizens use a device to store cloud invoices and do not print electronic invoices, they can enjoy double the chances of winning. If they complete mobile phone code registration and set up automatic transfer accounts by July 24, NT$10 million and other prizes will be automatically transferred to their designated accounts starting from August 6, and they will also be exempt from stamp duty, making it convenient and cost-effective.

items.title: 德微Q2毛利率回升至4成 7月營收再創新高
items.title_en: De Micro Q2 Profit Margin Rises to 40% 7M Revenue Sets New High
paras: 德微 (3675-TW) 今 (4) 日公告 7 月營收 2.91 億元，月增 3.97%，年增 29.78%，再創單月營收新高，累計前 7 月營收達 17.76 億元，年成長 19.02%。德微指出，受惠客戶需求強勁、高附加價值出貨攀升，7 月營收續創新高，第二季則隨著產品組合優化，毛利率回升至 4 成，創下歷史次高，每股稅後純益達 2 元，
德微第二季營收 8.01 億元，季增 16.99%，年增 24.52%，毛利率 40.8%，季增 2.5 個百分點，年增 8.2 個百分點，營業淨利 1.41 億元，季增 38.05%，年增 554.49%，稅後純益 1.06 億元，季增 32.5%，年增 322.36%，每股稅後純益 2 元。
德微上半年營收 14.86 億元，年增 17.11%，毛利率 39.6%，年增 4.4 個百分點，營業淨利 2.43 億元，年增 142.15%，稅後純益 1.86 億元，年增 611.17%，每股稅後純益 3.51 元。
上半年累計營收達 14.85 億元，毛利率升至 4 成，稅後純益 1.86 億元，較去年同期大幅成長 611%，每股盈餘（EPS）3.51 元，營收與獲利同步攀升。
德微表示，今年以來受惠 AI 應用、車用電子與工控產品需求強勁，加上客戶低庫存回補，以及高附加價值產品出貨比重提升，帶動整體營運規模擴大，稼動率全面上揚。因應終端應用需求持續成長，德微積極推動產品升級，並深化與國內外客戶的合作，以掌握功率半導體產業的成長契機。

paras_en: De Micro (3675-TW) announced 7M revenue of NT$2.91 billion, up 3.97% MoM and 29.78% YoY, setting a new high for a single month. De Micro stated that it has benefited from strong demand for AI applications, automotive electronics, and industrial control products, as well as customer restocking and increased sales of high-value-added products. In response to the growing demand for terminal applications, De Micro has actively promoted product upgrades and deepened cooperation with domestic and foreign customers to seize the growth opportunities in the power semiconductor industry.

De Micro has continued to deepen its IDM layout, with its subsidiary Axiom Technology responsible for wafer manufacturing, De Micro focusing on power component packaging, and its sales channel subsidiary Kiox expanding the market. De Micro is optimistic about the future, citing the global semiconductor supply chain reorganization and increasing customer demand for diversified supply sources. Looking ahead to the second half of the year, De Micro expects to continue optimizing its product mix and operational efficiency, as well as actively pursuing new customers and cooperation opportunities brought about by the global supply chain adjustment. The company is confident in its operational performance in the second half of the year.

In addition, its subsidiary Axiom Technology has initiated a stock listing and plans to list on the Emerging Stock Market. In the future, the group will leverage the professional division of labor among its subsidiaries to maintain upstream and downstream synergy while enhancing the operational autonomy and market expansion capabilities of each business unit, injecting growth momentum into the group's long-term development.

items.title: 絕無蓋牌！金管會推官方台股儀表板 拚第3季底前上線
items.title_en: No Hidden Cards! Financial Supervisory Commission Pushes Official Taiwan Stock Dashboard, Aiming for Launch Before End of Q3
paras: 台股上月底劇烈修正，一度跌破 4 萬點大關，部分民間平台推估個股維持率引發斷頭恐慌，證交所多次澄清，現行制度是以整戶信用交易部位合併計算，並無單一個股低於 130% 即追繳的機制。金管會今 (4) 日亦強調「沒有蓋牌、只有亮牌」，已責成證交所整合大家最關心的數據，包含融資餘額、整戶擔保維持率等，規劃以「儀表板」方式呈現，預計於第 3 季底前推出，全面提升市場資訊透明度。
針對外界關切信用交易資訊與維持率等議題，證期局副局長黃仲豪指出，金管會對於資本市場的管理立場是「盡量提供正確、完整、即時的資訊給大眾參考」，秉持安全、透明、公平原則。包含信用交易融資餘額、整戶擔保維持率、借券賣出占比等重要數據，將會完整提供給投資人參閱，目前證交所正在研議，努力在今年第 3 季底前上線。
至於是否提供歷史數據回溯，黃仲豪說，將再與交易所評估資料完整性後研商。而民間機構如 CMoney 先前已經下架大盤融資維持率相關資訊，未來要如何發布運算數據，金管會予以尊重。
日前有媒體頻引用民間平台發布的「擔保維持率」，造成投資人誤以為特定個股低於 130% 即將面臨斷頭，證交所多次發布新聞稿澄清，指出現行制度絕不存在「單一個股擔保維持率低於 130% 即代表將遭追繳或斷頭」的機制。
依現行規定，信用交易擔保維持率是以投資人「整戶」部位作為管理基礎，採融資、融券合併計算，並涵蓋投資人持有的所有上市、上櫃信用交易部位及抵繳擔保品。券商辦理追繳或處分 (斷頭)，完全看「整戶維持率」是否達標，而非看單一個股。
民間平台因無法掌握投資人整戶的實際持股、融資券組合及其他抵繳擔保品等完整資訊，其推估之「個股維持率」無法反映真實信用風險。若投資人以此進行買賣決策，恐因誤判市場風險而增加自身損失，甚至造成個股價格不必要的過度波動。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks underwent a sharp correction at the end of last month, briefly falling below the 40,000-point mark. Some private platforms estimated individual stock maintenance ratios, sparking panic about margin calls. The Taiwan Stock Exchange repeatedly clarified that the current system calculates margin positions on a whole‑account basis, and there is no mechanism that triggers a call when a single stock falls below 130%. On the 4th, the Financial Supervisory Commission also emphasized "no hidden cards, only open cards" and tasked the exchange with integrating the data most investors care about—such as financing balances and whole‑account maintenance ratios—into a "dashboard" format, expected to be released before the end of the third quarter, thereby enhancing market information transparency.

Regarding public concerns about credit‑trading information and maintenance ratios, Deputy Director of the Securities and Futures Bureau Huang Zhong‑hao said the FSC’s stance on capital‑market oversight is to "provide the public with accurate, complete, and timely information" while upholding safety, transparency, and fairness. Important data—including credit‑trading financing balances, whole‑account maintenance ratios, and the proportion of securities borrowed for short selling—will be fully disclosed to investors. The exchange is currently studying the implementation and aims to go live before the end of Q3 this year.

As for whether historical data will be made available for back‑testing, Huang said this will be examined with the exchange after assessing data completeness. Private firms such as CMoney have already removed market‑wide financing‑maintenance‑ratio information; how they will publish calculated data in the future will be respected by the FSC.

Recently, media outlets repeatedly cited "maintenance ratios" released by private platforms, leading investors to mistakenly believe that a specific stock falling below 130% would face an imminent margin call. The exchange has issued multiple press releases to clarify that the current system does not contain any mechanism whereby a "single‑stock maintenance ratio below 130%" triggers a call or forced liquidation.

Under existing regulations, the credit‑trading maintenance ratio is based on the investor’s "whole‑account" position, combining financing and securities‑lending balances and covering all listed and over‑the‑counter credit‑trading positions as well as collateral. Brokers’ decisions to issue margin calls or enforce liquidations depend entirely on whether the whole‑account maintenance ratio meets the required level, not on any individual stock.

Because private platforms cannot access an investor’s complete holdings, financing‑securities portfolio, and other collateral, their estimated "stock‑specific maintenance ratios" do not reflect the true credit risk. If investors base trading decisions on these figures, they may misjudge market risk, increase their own losses, and even cause unnecessary price volatility in the affected stocks.

items.title_en: Fresh Juice - KY Enters Peak Season, July Revenue Grows Both Month-over-Month and Year-over-Year, Cumulative Jan‑July Hits Record High
paras: 鮮活果汁 - KY(1256-TW) 今 (4) 日公布最新營收資訊，2026 年 7 月營收幣 6.19 億元，月成長 7.6%、年增 21.99%，累計 2026 年 1-7 月營收 32.67 億元，年增 41.87%。主要受惠中國新茶飲市場進入夏季消費旺季。鮮活的昆山新廠預計近期投入營運，將進一步提升整體供貨能力。
同時，鮮活果汁 - KY 指出，品牌客戶拉貨需求持續升溫，加上公司持續深化產品布局及提升供應能力，帶動 7 月營收繳出年月雙增佳績。
鮮活果汁 - KY 係因適逢暑期消費旺季來臨，各大新茶飲品牌持續推出季節限定飲品及水果茶新品，帶動果汁、風味飲品等原料需求穩定成長，公司憑藉完整的產品研發實力、供應鏈整合能力及長期深耕客戶基礎，持續掌握市場商機，推升整體接單及出貨動能。同時公司持續優化產品組合，提升高附加價值產品比重，為整體營運成長增添動能，累計 1-7 月營收 32.67 億元，創歷年同期新高。
為因應直飲產品市場快速發展，鮮活果汁 - KY 昆山新廠預計近期投入營運，進一步提升整體供貨能力。新廠亦持續擴充直飲產品產能，助力直飲產品業務成長，並整合 MES 製造執行系統及 WMS 倉儲管理系統，建構具高度彈性的智慧生產模式，可依市場需求快速調整產線配置，兼顧客製化小量訂單與大規模量產需求，不僅提升人均產值與生產效率，更進一步鞏固鮮活於中國大陸新茶飲供應鏈的競爭優勢。
paras_en: Fresh Juice - KY (1256‑TW) announced today (the 4th) its latest revenue figures: July 2026 revenue was NT$619 million, up 7.6% month‑over‑month and 21.99% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑July 2026 reached NT$3.267 billion, a 41.87% increase year‑over‑year. The growth was mainly driven by the Chinese new‑tea‑drink market entering its summer consumption peak. Fresh Juice’s new plant in Kunshan is expected to start operations soon, further boosting overall supply capacity.

At the same time, Fresh Juice - KY noted that brand customers’ pull‑forward ordering demand continues to heat up, and the company’s ongoing deepening of product placement and supply capability helped deliver the strong double‑digit growth in July.

The summer consumption peak has prompted major new‑tea‑drink brands to launch seasonal limited‑edition drinks and new fruit‑tea products, driving steady growth in demand for juice, flavored beverages and other raw materials. Leveraging its comprehensive product R&D strength, supply‑chain integration capability, and long‑standing customer relationships, the company continues to capture market opportunities, boosting overall order intake and shipment momentum. The firm also keeps optimizing its product mix to increase the proportion of high‑value‑added items, adding further momentum to overall operational growth. Cumulative Jan‑July revenue of NT$3.267 billion set a new high for the same period in company history.

To meet the rapid development of the ready‑to‑drink product market, Fresh Juice - KY’s new Kunshan plant is slated to commence operations soon, further enhancing overall supply capacity. The new facility is also expanding ready‑to‑drink production capacity to support business growth, and is integrating a MES manufacturing execution system and a WMS warehouse management system to build a highly flexible smart manufacturing model. This allows quick adjustments of production lines according to market demand, accommodating both small‑batch customized orders and large‑scale mass production. The upgrades not only raise per‑employee output and production efficiency but also further solidify Fresh Juice’s competitive advantage in China’s new‑tea‑drink supply chain.

items.title: 防範信用過度擴張！金管會10月起逐月掌握「個人理財周轉金」
items.title_en: Preventing Over-Expansion of Credit! FSC to Monitor Personal Financial Turnover Funds Monthly Starting October
paras: 近年台股交投熱絡，甚至出現「四貸同堂」現象，許多投資人靈活運用信貸、房貸、車貸及股票質押等多重管道籌措資金，放大投資槓桿，日前央行也發聲示警。金管會今 (4) 日表示，已要求國銀於 10 月起申報個人理財周轉金數字，藉由滾動監控資金脈絡，防範過度擴張信用所引發的系統性金融風險。
為了釐清個人借貸周轉金中究竟有多少資金流入股票、基金等金融商品，目前銀行向中央銀行申報的資料中，已有「投資股票等金融商品的理財周轉金貸款」這項數據，但銀行向金管會申報資料中尚無。
金管會銀行局副局長王允中表示，過去銀行申報周轉金多將企業與個人混合計算，且以擔保品分類，缺乏單純針對「個人理財用途」的統計。為此，金管會已要求本國銀行新增申報「個人理財周轉金」項目。
王允中說明，銀行僅需向金管會申報一個「總金額」數字，不需分項列出。資金須為個人借款，且客戶向銀行明確表明或勾選用途為「投資理財」，意指廣泛的金融商品，包括股票、基金、債券、投資型保單及衍生性商品等。
涵蓋業務包括：理財型房貸、房貸增貸 (非用於購屋者)、股票質押 / 有價證券擔保貸款、個人信用貸款，以及少數其他周轉金 (如獨資合夥企業主營運周轉金或員工認購自家股票專案貸款)。
配合銀行端系統調整，本國銀行將於 10 月份正式開始申報 9 月份的資料，作為金管會進行持續性風險控管的依據。
paras_en: In recent years, the Taiwan stock market has been hot, with the phenomenon of 'four loans in one room' emerging. Many investors have been using multiple channels such as credit, mortgage, car loan, and stock pledge to raise funds, thereby amplifying their investment leverage. The central bank has recently issued a warning. The FSC announced today (4th) that it has asked domestic banks to report personal financial turnover funds starting from October, using rolling monitoring to prevent systemic financial risks triggered by excessive credit expansion.

To clarify how much of the personal loan turnover funds have flowed into stocks, funds, and other financial products, the current bank data submitted to the central bank already includes the data item 'investment in stocks and other financial products through financial turnover loans', but there is no such data item in the data submitted to the FSC.

FSC Banking Bureau Deputy Director Wang Yunzhong pointed out that in the past, banks have reported turnover funds by mixing corporate and personal data, and classified by collateral, lacking a simple statistical approach to 'personal financial purposes'. Therefore, the FSC has asked domestic banks to add a new reporting item 'personal financial turnover funds'.

Wang Yunzhong explained that banks only need to report a 'total amount' number to the FSC, without breaking it down into individual items. The funds must be personal loans, and the customer must explicitly indicate or tick the purpose as 'investment and finance', meaning a wide range of financial products, including stocks, funds, bonds, investment-type insurance, and derivative products.

The scope of business includes: financial-type mortgage loans, mortgage refinancing (not for purchasing a house), stock pledge / securities collateral loans, personal credit loans, and a few other turnover funds (such as sole proprietorship business owner's operating turnover funds or employee stock purchase project loans).

In conjunction with the adjustment of the bank's system, domestic banks will officially start reporting data for September in October, serving as the basis for the FSC to conduct ongoing risk management.

items.title: BBU即將大出貨，但市場都在關注這件事
items.title_en: BBU Is About to Ship in Large Volumes, but the Market Is Focused on This Issue
paras: 2026年08月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ BBU 目前已經是市場普遍認可的成長題材，接下來真正值得關注的，已經不只是出貨量是否持續增加，而是公司的毛利率是否能夠維持。
從法人預估與實際毛利率表現的落差來看，BBU 產業後續的競爭變化，值得進一步觀察。
至少可以看到ASP或產品組合壓力已經開始成為市場留意的焦點。
從台灣主要供應商來看，AES-KY(6781-TW)與順達(3211-TW)都搭上了BBU需求擴張的趨勢，但兩家公司反映在財報上的結果，已經開始出現差異。
BBU 目前主要的出貨模式仍是跟著台達電(2308-TW)、光寶科(2301-TW)等電源廠的電源櫃平台走。
但隨著伺服器電源櫃放量出貨，市場觀察到的並不是完全一致的獲利反映。
AES-KY原先以直供CSP為主，後續也規劃加入供應電源廠BBU產品的行列。
不過，如果把毛利率拉出來看，由於先前市場擔心電源廠有相對較好的議價能力，以及公司產品組合狀況等因素，使得毛利率可能受到影響。
而公司實際的毛利率也已經從先前的高檔，約40%左右開始回落，最低來到34%，後續獲利表現仍需要持續觀察。
而一直都是供貨給電源廠的順達，其第二季的財報表現卻沒有跟上市場對BBU放量的期待。
從Q2實際毛利率與法人共識的預估落差來看，順達的表現大幅不如預期7%。
BBU這個市場發展至今需要留意產業面臨競爭壓力；最重要的觀察指標是市場共識與毛利率的差異，因為市場早就知道BBU要大量出貨。
從AES-KY與順達的獲利情況來看，這背後代表在出貨之前比的是訂單量，出貨之後檢視獲利率更重要。
因為這是能否維持高評價(本益比)的條件。

paras_en: August 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – BBU has already become a widely recognized growth theme in the market. Going forward, the real focus is no longer just whether shipment volumes keep rising, but whether the company can maintain its gross margin.

Looking at the gap between analysts' estimates and actual gross‑margin performance, the competitive dynamics in the BBU industry merit close monitoring. At the very least, pressure on ASPs or product mix has already become a focal point for the market.
Among Taiwan’s main suppliers, AES‑KY (6781‑TW) and Shunda (3211‑TW) have both ridden the wave of expanding BBU demand, yet their financial‑report results are beginning to diverge.

BBU’s primary shipment model still follows the power‑cabinet platforms of power‑supply manufacturers such as Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and Lite‑On Technology (2301‑TW). However, as server power cabinets scale up, the profit impact observed in the market is not uniformly positive.

AES‑KY originally supplied CSPs directly and later planned to join the ranks of power‑supply vendors offering BBU products. Yet, when gross margin is examined, earlier market concerns about power‑supply firms’ stronger bargaining power and the company’s product‑mix situation suggest margin pressure.
The company’s actual gross margin has already slipped from its previous high of around 40% down to a low of 34%, and future profitability will need continued observation.

Shunda, which has always supplied power‑supply manufacturers, saw its Q2 earnings fall short of market expectations for a BBU volume surge. The gap between Q2 actual gross margin and analysts’ consensus estimate was a disappointing 7 percentage points.

The BBU market’s development now requires attention to industry competitive pressure; the most important metric is the divergence between market consensus and gross margin, because the market has long known that BBU will ship in large volumes.

From the profit performance of AES‑KY and Shunda, the takeaway is that before shipment the battle is over order quantity, but after shipment the focus shifts to profit margin – a key condition for sustaining a high valuation (P/E ratio).

paras:
一、 達方 (8163-TW) 2026 年第二季財務與營運詳情

財務表現：

• 營收與獲利： 2026 年第二季合併營收達新臺幣 75.17 億元，季增 24.8%、年增 8.9%。營業毛利為 12.46 億元（季增 15.1%、年增 12.1%），營業毛利率微幅下滑至 16.6%。營業利益回升至 4.18 億元，營業利益率約 5.5%。歸屬於母公司股東淨利為 8.6 億元（季增 51.6%、年增 47%），單季基本每股盈餘（EPS）為 NT$0.31 元。
• 上半年累積： 2026 上半年合併營收為 NT$135.42 億元，年增 9.32%；營業毛利率約 17.2%（年增 11.5%）；營業淨利為 2.27 億元（年增 42.8%）；歸屬母公司淨利為 1.43 億元（年增 19%），上半年 EPS 為 NT$0.51 元。
• 資產與現金流： 截至第二季底，現金及約當現金接近 60.8 億元，資產總計 345 億元，每股淨值為 NT$38.4 元。上半年資本支出約 5 億元（70% 用於自動化設備與生產模具，30% 用於越南新廠擴建），併購海昌支出約 3.8 億元。

三大事業群營收結構：

• 綠能產品（Green Energy）： 2Q 營收佔比升至 45%（上半年平均為 42%），主因歐洲綠能通路業務大幅回升及 E-bike 成長帶動。
• IT 周邊產品（IT Peripherals）： 2Q 營收佔比降至 43%（上半年平均為 46%），營收雖呈季成長，但增幅低於綠能事業。
• 整合元件（Integrated Components）： 2Q 及上半年營收佔比均維持在 12% 左右，維持雙位數季增長。

市場展望與營運策略：

• 下半年營收展望： 對整體下半年營運持樂觀態度，全年營收預期目標不變。綠能與非綠能（IT 周邊 + 整合元件 + AIoT）營收比重預計維持在約 42：58 的大方向。
• 被動元件（MLCC）供需： 由於日韓廠商將產能轉向 AI 伺服器的高階需求，導致部分高階產品緊缺、交期拉長。公司目前產能利用率極高，去年定案購置的新設備已於今年 8~9 月陸續投入增產高壓、高容等特規品，價格調漲趨勢仍在進行中。
• 綠能庫存去化與轉型： E-bike 庫存處理預計於今年年底告一段落，明年庫存壓力將回歸健康狀態。同時，電池產品逐步從輕型 Mobility/E-bike 延伸至工業用、機器人、無人機，長遠目標亦包含規劃進入 Data Center 領域的 BBU（備援電池單元）。
• 併購布局與 AIoT 轉型： 併購海昌（High-Tide，電源）與佺璟（散熱），結合達方自身的電池技術，構築「散熱 + 電源 + 電池」三合一戰略，鎖定 AI Data Center 與 Server 邊緣端（Edge）切入需求。

【達方法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)】

Q1：被動元件（MLCC）的產能利用率為何？是否有擴產計畫？

回答： 目前被動元件產能利用率相當高，處於供不應求狀態。過去產能規模約在 5 到 10 B 左右（視規格而定）。去年已預先購置新設備，剛好用於今年下半年的增產計畫。未來是否繼續大幅擴產將視明年市場景氣延續狀況而定。

Q2：資本支出（CapEx）中 70% 自動化與 30% 越南擴產的具體細節為何？

回答： 70% 生產設備投資包含：IT 周邊在越南新廠的自動化建設、MLCC 生產設備投入，以及電池業務的設備投資。30% 廠房資本支出主要是子公司泰宇科技在南越規劃建設的新廠房。

Q3：綠能產品在非 E-bike 部分是否轉向 BBU？未來的產品提升規劃？

回答： BBU 針對 Data Center 與 Server，對安規與耐用度（高壓如 800V）要求極高，需要長期驗證。公司近 1~2 年的規劃會優先提升 Mobility（包含工業用、機器人、無人機）的 Non-bike 比重，長期則將 BBU 等大顆電池視為發展目標之一。

Q4：綠能產品（E-bike）的庫存去化進度與訂單能見度為何？

回答： 公司持續清理庫存，希望整體 Mobility（含整車與原物料庫存）能於今年年底告一段落，使明年恢復健康狀態。市場競爭方面，1,000 美元以下低階市場競爭激烈，高價位市場仍有需求；達方的製造（太宇、永捷）與電池業務正加速轉型及調整產品策略。

Q5：公司下半年的毛利率展望為何？

回答： 上半年毛利率約落在 16~17% 之間（2Q 為 16.6%），主因原物料漲價未能完全轉嫁。下半年將透過場區（Site）精實整併、適時反映成本給客戶，加上高毛利周邊產品與綠能庫存去化回升，目標是將毛利率維持在 18% 以上，並持續往 20% 目標邁進。

Q6：今年 2 月併購海昌與佺璟的戰略與效益為何？

回答： 兩家公司分別做電源與散熱，結合達方既有的電池產品，形成「散熱 + 電源 + 電池」三大 AI Data Center 與 Server 的核心要素。目前正從 Edge 端與 Low-end 客戶切入，協助達方的周邊與元件事業向 AIoT 及 AI 應用領域擴展轉型。

Q7：MLCC 特規品的價格趨勢與變動狀況為何？

回答： 因日系廠商產能移往 Data Center，高階高容產品交期拉長且供需尚未平衡。達方的新設備於 8、9 月投入後將增加高壓、高容產能；價格調漲屬於進行式，下半年預計維持此一趨勢。
paras_en: Dahua Technology (8163-TW) reported its second quarter 2026 financial results, with consolidated revenue reaching NT$75.17 billion, a 24.8% increase from the previous quarter and an 8.9% increase from the same period last year.

Gross profit was NT$12.46 billion, a 15.1% increase from the previous quarter and a 12.1% increase from the same period last year, with a gross margin of 16.6%. Operating income rose to NT$4.18 billion, with an operating margin of approximately 5.5%. Net income attributable to shareholders was NT$8.6 billion, a 51.6% increase from the previous quarter and a 47% increase from the same period last year, with a basic earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.31.

For the first half of 2026, consolidated revenue was NT$135.42 billion, a 9.32% increase from the same period last year. Gross margin was approximately 17.2% (a 11.5% increase from the same period last year), with operating net income of NT$2.27 billion (a 42.8% increase from the same period last year) and net income attributable to shareholders of NT$1.43 billion (a 19% increase from the same period last year), with a first-half EPS of NT$0.51.

As of the end of the second quarter, cash and cash equivalents were approximately NT$60.8 billion, with total assets of NT$345 billion and a net asset value per share of NT$38.4. Capital expenditures for the first half were approximately NT$5 billion (70% for automation equipment and production molds, and 30% for the expansion of the new factory in Vietnam), with merger and acquisition expenses of approximately NT$3.8 billion.
The three major business groups' revenue structure:
• Green Energy: 2Q revenue accounted for 45% (average 42% for the first half), mainly due to a significant increase in European green energy channel business and the growth of E-bike sales.
• IT Peripherals: 2Q revenue accounted for 43% (average 46% for the first half), with revenue growth in the quarter, but lower than the growth of the Green Energy business.
• Integrated Components: 2Q and first-half revenue accounted for approximately 12% each, maintaining double-digit quarterly growth.
Market outlook and operating strategy:

• Downstream revenue outlook: The company is optimistic about the overall downstream operation in the second half, with the annual revenue target unchanged. The revenue ratio of Green Energy to non-Green Energy (IT peripherals + Integrated Components + AIoT) is expected to remain around 42:58.

• Passive components (MLCC) supply and demand: Due to the shift of production capacity from Japanese and Korean companies to high-end AI server demand, there is a shortage of high-end products, leading to longer delivery times. The company's current production capacity utilization is extremely high, with new equipment purchased last year to be put into production in August and September, and the price increase trend is expected to continue in the second half.

• Green energy inventory clearing and transformation: The company expects to clear E-bike inventory by the end of this year, with a healthy inventory situation expected next year. At the same time, the company is gradually extending its battery products from lightweight mobility/E-bike to industrial use, robots, and drones, with a long-term goal of entering the data center market with BBU (backup battery unit).

• M&A layout and AIoT transformation: The company has acquired High-Tide (power) and Shangjin (heat dissipation), combining its own battery technology to form a "heat dissipation + power + battery" three-in-one strategy, targeting AI data center and server edge entry demand.
Q&A:
Q1: What is the production capacity utilization rate of passive components (MLCC)? Is there a plan to expand production?

A1: The current production capacity utilization rate of passive components is extremely high, with a supply and demand imbalance. Last year, new equipment was purchased to be put into production in the second half of this year. Whether to continue to expand production will depend on the market situation next year.
Q2: What are the specific details of the capital expenditures (CapEx) of NT$5 billion, with 70% for automation and 30% for Vietnam expansion?

A2: The 70% investment in production equipment includes: automation construction in the new factory in Vietnam, MLCC production equipment, and equipment investment in battery business. The 30% capital expenditure is mainly for the construction of a new factory in Vietnam by a subsidiary.
Q3: Will the Green Energy business shift to BBU in the non-E-bike segment? What are the plans for product upgrades?

A3: BBU is a high-end product with high reliability and durability requirements, which needs long-term verification. The company's plans for the next 1-2 years will focus on upgrading mobility (including industrial use, robots, and drones) in the non-bike segment, with BBU as a long-term development goal.
Q4: What is the progress of clearing E-bike inventory and the visibility of orders?

A4: The company is continuously clearing inventory, aiming to complete the clearing of mobility (including vehicle and raw material inventory) by the end of this year, with a healthy inventory situation expected next year. In terms of market competition, the low-end market below $1,000 is highly competitive, while the high-end market still has demand; the company's manufacturing (Taoyu and Yongjie) and battery business are accelerating transformation and adjusting product strategies.
Q5: What is the company's revenue growth target for the second half?

A5: The gross margin for the first half was approximately 16-17% (2Q was 16.6%), mainly due to the inability to fully pass on the increase in raw materials. In the second half, the company will implement site consolidation, reflect costs to customers in a timely manner, and add high-margin peripherals and green energy inventory clearing, aiming to maintain a gross margin of 18% or higher and continue to move towards a 20% target.
Q6: What is the strategy and benefit of the acquisition of High-Tide and Shangjin in February this year?

A6: The two companies specialize in power and heat dissipation, respectively, combining with Dahua's existing battery products to form a "heat dissipation + power + battery" three-core strategy for AI data center and server edge entry. Currently, the company is cutting into the edge and low-end customer markets, helping Dahua's peripherals and component businesses to transform and expand into AIoT and AI applications.
Q7: What is the trend and variation of the price of MLCC special products?

A7: Due to the shift of production capacity from Japanese and Korean companies to high-end AI server demand, there is a shortage of high-end products, leading to longer delivery times. Dahua's new equipment will be put into production in August and September, increasing high-pressure and high-capacity production capacity; the price increase trend is expected to continue in the second half.

items.title: 2026台日經貿論壇 工商協進會：雙方互補產業優勢共創區域繁榮韌性
items.title_en: 2026 Taiwan-Japan Economic Forum: Bilateral Cooperation to Create Regional Resilience
paras: 為深化台日經貿夥伴關係，促進雙方產業交流與供應鏈合作，工商協進會與日本「中部經濟連合會」於今 (4) 日下午在台北國際會議中心共同舉辦「2026 台日經貿論壇」。工商協進會副理事長黃教漳表示，台日雙方擁高度互補的產業優勢，未來若能結合雙方的技術、人才與市場資源，不僅能創造更多商業契機，更能共同提升亞洲供應鏈韌性，為區域經濟注入強勁的成長動能。
本次論壇聚焦「智慧移動」與「防災應變」兩大核心議題，廣邀台日產官學界要員深度對談，包括面對 AI、數位轉型、綠色轉型快速發展，以及全球供應鏈重組與地緣政治變化加速的國際情勢。
黃教漳致詞時，首先代表工商協進會全體會員，就日前熊本地震災情向中經連會長勝野哲表達誠摯關懷與慰問，也表示去 (2025) 年理事長吳東亮率團訪問日本中部地區考察後，本次勝野會長率團回訪台灣，不僅象徵雙方交流邁入新里程碑，更展現持續深化合作、共創區域繁榮的堅定決心。
勝野哲則表示，日本中部地區身為日本製造業重鎮，目前正積極推動「中部圈願景」。期盼藉由此次訪台考察，深化對台灣半導體與高科技產業、產官學合作模式，以及防災應變經驗的了解，並將相關成果應用於日本中部地區，進一步提升製造業競爭力與區域韌性。
勝野會長補充，未來將持續推動人員往來與民間經濟交流，透過跨國界與跨領域的人才合作，共同因應國際能源波動與經濟不確定性的挑戰。同時，也期待台灣與日本中部企業持續建立更緊密的夥伴關係，共同為全球經濟發展貢獻力量。
本次論壇首先由台日雙方代表各自簡介兩會的會務發展與核心業務現況，說明雙方在促進企業交流、推動區域治理及產業升級上的努力與成果，進一步增進產官學各界對兩會運作機制與合作資源的瞭解。
在完成會務簡介後，論壇隨即展開兩大專業主題的深度交流。在「智慧移動」領域，由車王電 (1533-TW) 集團華德動能 (2237-TW) 科技總經理楊誌榮，分享電動巴士與智慧交通的創新實踐與應用，並由中經連擔當部長和田耕一朗，介紹日本中部推動智慧移動與區域發展的最新實績。
在「防災應變」領域，則由全家 (5903-TW) 便利商店會員數據創研部部長黃士杰分享企業防災與數據應用的實務經驗，並由中經連常務理事事務局長梅村理史分享日本中部地區在災害應變與區域韌性建構的精闢觀點，透過台日雙方企業與專家的經驗碰撞，現場激盪出許多創新思維，不僅促進產業合作新模式也產出豐碩的交流成果。
paras_en: To deepen Taiwan-Japan economic partnership and promote industry exchange and supply chain cooperation, the Taiwan Businessmen's Association and Japan's Central Economic Federation held the 2026 Taiwan-Japan Economic Forum at the Taipei International Convention Center on April 4. Taiwan Businessmen's Association Vice Chairman Huang Jiaozhang said that Taiwan and Japan have highly complementary industry advantages. If they can combine their technologies, talents, and market resources, they can not only create more business opportunities but also enhance the resilience of the Asian supply chain and inject strong growth momentum into regional economies.

The forum focused on two core issues: 'Intelligent Mobility' and 'Disaster Response'. It invited Taiwan and Japan's officials, scholars, and industry leaders to have in-depth discussions, including the rapid development of AI, digital transformation, green transformation, and the reorganization of global supply chains and the acceleration of geopolitical changes.

Huang Jiaozhang spoke on behalf of the Taiwan Businessmen's Association, expressing sincere condolences and sympathy to Central Economic Federation Chairman Shigenobu Katsuno over the recent Kumamoto earthquake disaster. He also mentioned that the association's chairman, Wu Dongliang, led a delegation to visit Japan's central region in 2025 and that this visit by Chairman Katsuno's delegation to Taiwan represents a new milestone in bilateral exchanges and demonstrates their determination to deepen cooperation and create regional prosperity.

Katsuno said that Japan's central region is the country's manufacturing hub and is actively promoting the 'Central Region Vision'. He hopes to deepen their understanding of Taiwan's semiconductor and high-tech industries, as well as their cooperation models and disaster response experiences through this visit, and apply the results to Japan's central region to further enhance its manufacturing competitiveness and regional resilience.

Katsuno added that they will continue to promote personnel exchanges and private economic cooperation, leveraging cross-border and cross-disciplinary talent cooperation to respond to international energy fluctuations and economic uncertainties. They also expect Taiwan and Japan's central region companies to establish closer partnerships and contribute to global economic development.

The forum first had representatives from both sides introduce their respective organizations' development and core business situations, explaining their efforts and achievements in promoting enterprise exchanges, driving regional governance, and upgrading industries, and further increasing the understanding of the operation mechanisms and cooperation resources of both organizations among officials, scholars, and industry leaders.

After completing the introduction of their work, the forum proceeded with in-depth discussions on two professional topics. In the 'Intelligent Mobility' field, Wangde Dynamic Technology General Manager Yang Zhirong shared his innovative practices and applications of electric buses and intelligent transportation, while Central Economic Federation Director and Department Head Ando Kojiro introduced the latest achievements of Japan's central region in promoting intelligent mobility and regional development.

In the 'Disaster Response' field, FamilyMart Data Research Department Director Huang Shijie shared his practical experiences in enterprise disaster response and data applications, while Central Economic Federation General Affairs Director and Bureau Chief Meimura Risuke shared his insightful views on disaster response and regional resilience construction in Japan's central region. Through the collision of experiences between Taiwan and Japan's enterprises and experts, the forum sparked many innovative ideas, not only promoting new industry cooperation models but also producing rich exchange results.

items.title: 德微Q2毛利率回升至4成 7月營收再創新高
items.title_en: De Micro Q2 Profit Margin Rises to 40% 7M Revenue Sets New High
paras: 德微 (3675-TW) 今 (4) 日公告 7 月營收 2.91 億元，月增 3.97%，年增 29.78%，再創單月營收新高，累計前 7 月營收達 17.76 億元，年成長 19.02%。德微指出，受惠客戶需求強勁、高附加價值出貨攀升，7 月營收續創新高，第二季則隨著產品組合優化，毛利率回升至 4 成，創下歷史次高，每股稅後純益達 2 元，
德微第二季營收 8.01 億元，季增 16.99%，年增 24.52%，毛利率 40.8%，季增 2.5 個百分點，年增 8.2 個百分點，營業淨利 1.41 億元，季增 38.05%，年增 554.49%，稅後純益 1.06 億元，季增 32.5%，年增 322.36%，每股稅後純益 2 元。
德微上半年營收 14.86 億元，年增 17.11%，毛利率 39.6%，年增 4.4 個百分點，營業淨利 2.43 億元，年增 142.15%，稅後純益 1.86 億元，年增 611.17%，每股稅後純益 3.51 元。
上半年累計營收達 14.85 億元，毛利率升至 4 成，稅後純益 1.86 億元，較去年同期大幅成長 611%，每股盈餘（EPS）3.51 元，營收與獲利同步攀升。
德微表示，今年以來受惠 AI 應用、車用電子與工控產品需求強勁，加上客戶低庫存回補，以及高附加價值產品出貨比重提升，帶動整體營運規模擴大，稼動率全面上揚。因應終端應用需求持續成長，德微積極推動產品升級，並深化與國內外客戶的合作，以掌握功率半導體產業的成長契機。
德微近年持續深化 IDM 布局，由旗下子公司亞昕科技負責晶圓製造，德微聚焦功率元件封裝，並透過銷售通路子公司喜可士拓展市場，建構涵蓋晶圓製造、封裝及銷售的垂直整合體系，持續強化產品開發、產能調度與客戶服務，相關綜效亦逐步反映於營運表現。
德微看好，隨著全球半導體供應鏈重組，以及客戶對供應來源多元化的需求增加，公司憑藉自主製造、品質管理、供貨彈性及產品客製化能力，持續強化國際競爭優勢，並加速布局高附加價值產品應用。
展望下半年，德微表示，隨著高毛利產品逐步放量，公司將持續優化產品組合與營運效率，並積極爭取全球供應鏈調整所帶來的新客戶與合作機會，對下半年營運表現深具信心。
此外，子公司亞昕科技已啟動股票公開發行，並規劃登錄興櫃。未來，集團將透過各子公司的專業分工，在維持上下游協同效益的同時，提升各事業體的營運自主性與市場拓展能力，為集團長期發展挹注成長動能。
paras_en: De Micro (3675-TW) announced 7M revenue of NT$2.91 billion, up 3.97% MoM and 29.78% YoY, setting a new high for a single month. Cumulative 7M revenue reached NT$17.76 billion, up 19.02% YoY. De Micro attributed the strong revenue growth to robust customer demand and increased sales of high-value-added products.

De Micro's Q2 revenue reached NT$8.01 billion, up 16.99% QoQ and 24.52% YoY. Gross margin rose to 40.8%, up 2.5 percentage points QoQ and 8.2 percentage points YoY. Operating net income reached NT$1.41 billion, up 38.05% QoQ and 554.49% YoY. Net income after tax was NT$1.06 billion, up 32.5% QoQ and 322.36% YoY. Earnings per share (EPS) was NT$2.

De Micro's H1 revenue reached NT$14.86 billion, up 17.11% YoY. Gross margin rose to 39.6%, up 4.4 percentage points YoY. Operating net income reached NT$2.43 billion, up 142.15% YoY. Net income after tax was NT$1.86 billion, up 611.17% YoY. EPS was NT$3.51.

De Micro's H1 cumulative revenue reached NT$14.85 billion, with gross margin rising to 40% and net income after tax reaching NT$1.86 billion, a significant increase of 611% YoY. EPS was NT$3.51, with revenue and profitability both rising simultaneously.

De Micro stated that it has benefited from strong demand for AI applications, automotive electronics, and industrial control products, as well as customer restocking and increased sales of high-value-added products. This has driven the company's overall business scale expansion and improved operational efficiency.

In response to the growing demand for terminal applications, De Micro has actively promoted product upgrades and deepened cooperation with domestic and foreign customers to seize the growth opportunities in the power semiconductor industry.

De Micro has continued to deepen its IDM layout, with its subsidiary Axiom Technology responsible for wafer manufacturing, De Micro focusing on power component packaging, and its sales channel subsidiary Kiox expanding the market. This has established a vertical integration system covering wafer manufacturing, packaging, and sales, and has continuously strengthened product development, production capacity, and customer service.

De Micro is optimistic about the future, citing the global semiconductor supply chain reorganization and increasing customer demand for diversified supply sources. The company believes that its self-manufacturing, quality management, supply flexibility, and product customization capabilities will continue to strengthen its international competitiveness and accelerate its layout of high-value-added products.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, De Micro expects to continue optimizing its product mix and operational efficiency, as well as actively pursuing new customers and cooperation opportunities brought about by the global supply chain adjustment. The company is confident in its operational performance in the second half of the year.

In addition, its subsidiary Axiom Technology has initiated a stock listing and plans to list on the Emerging Stock Market. In the future, the group will leverage the professional division of labor among its subsidiaries to maintain upstream and downstream synergy while enhancing the operational autonomy and market expansion capabilities of each business unit, injecting growth momentum into the group's long-term development.

items.title: 〈達方法說〉MLCC緊缺加上AI電源業務助攻 樂觀看下半年營運
items.title_en: Dafang Optimistic About Second-Half Operations Due to MLCC Shortage and AI Power Business
paras: 電腦週邊廠達方 (8163-TW) 今 (4) 日舉辦法說會，總經理蔡曜坤表示，受惠於 MLCC 被動元件市場緊缺以及 AI 新局熱潮加持，公司樂觀看待下半年營運，雖然下半年仍需緊盯缺料、缺電及原物料漲價等產業變數，但在各事業群策略發酵下，整體營運動能依然符合預期。
在被動元件 MLCC 方面，總經理蔡曜坤分析，由於日韓大廠將產能轉向 AI 伺服器領域，導致高壓與高容等高階特規品出現供需失衡，帶動交期拉長與價格調漲。達方目前產能利用率相當高，去年訂購的新設備於 8 月與 9 月陸續投入增產，將可及時挹注下半年產能。
綠能事業則積極推動庫存去化與轉型，總經理蔡曜坤預計整車與原物料庫存將在今年底告一段落，明年營運可望回歸健康輕盈的狀態。針對 1,000 美元以下低價 E-bike 市場競爭加劇，公司將調整策略轉向高價產品，並拓展至工業用、機器人與無人機等非自行車領域。
為拓展 AI 資料中心龐大商機，總經理蔡曜坤說明，達方併購的海昌電子與佺璟兩家公司，將電源與散熱技術搭配既有電池能力，打造三大關鍵組件。公司規劃先從邊緣端與初級客戶切入，為 AIOT 事業群長出全新的成長支柱。
針對市場關注的備援電池系統 BBU，總經理蔡曜坤指出，由於 AI 數據中心電壓提升至 800V 以上，對電池安規與可信度要求極高。達方預計在 1 至 2 年內先提升工業用與機器人等大尺寸行動電池占比，長期則以進入伺服器 BBU 大電池市場為終極目標。
中長期財務表現方面，總經理蔡曜坤與財務長林豐正強調，達方將透過場區精實整併與產品組合優化，適度向客戶反映材料成本。公司目標將整體毛利率拉升並穩固在 18% 以上，未來更將朝向 20% 的優質獲利目標邁進。
paras_en: Dafang (8163-TW), a computer peripherals manufacturer, held an investor conference on the 4th, where General Manager Cai Yaokun expressed optimism about the company's second-half operations, thanks to the MLCC component shortage and the AI trend. Although the company still needs to monitor factors such as material shortages, power outages, and rising raw material prices in the second half, overall operations are expected to meet expectations due to the strategic development of various business groups.

Regarding MLCC components, General Manager Cai Yaokun analyzed that due to Japanese and Korean manufacturers shifting production capacity to the AI server field, high-end products with high pressure and high capacity are facing supply and demand imbalances, leading to extended delivery times and price increases. Dafang's current production capacity utilization rate is high, and new equipment purchased last year will be put into production in August and September, which will help increase production capacity in the second half.

In the green energy business, the company is actively promoting inventory reduction and transformation. General Manager Cai Yaokun expects that whole-vehicle and raw material inventory will be cleared by the end of the year, and operations are expected to return to a healthy and lean state next year. In response to the intensifying competition in the low-priced E-bike market below $1,000, the company will adjust its strategy to focus on high-priced products and expand into non-bicycle fields such as industrial, robotics, and drones.

To expand into the vast AI data center market, General Manager Cai Yaokun explained that Dafang's acquired companies, Haichang Electronics and Jiu Jing, will combine power and heat dissipation technologies with existing battery capabilities to create three key components. The company plans to start by entering the edge and primary customer markets, creating a new growth pillar for the AIOT business group.

Regarding the market's concerns about backup battery systems (BBU), General Manager Cai Yaokun pointed out that due to the increase in AI data center voltage to 800V or higher, the requirements for battery safety and reliability are extremely high. Dafang expects to increase the proportion of large-sized mobile batteries for industrial and robotic use within 1-2 years and aims to enter the server BBU large battery market in the long term.

In terms of mid-to-long-term financial performance, General Manager Cai Yaokun and Financial Director Lin Fengzheng emphasized that Dafang will optimize its product portfolio and reflect material costs to customers in a reasonable manner. The company aims to increase its overall gross margin to above 18% and strive for a high-quality profit target of 20% in the future.

items.title: 2027年DRAM仍供不應求 輝達下調Rubin Ultra HBM配置
items.title_en: DRAM Still Short of Supply Through 2027; Nvidia Lowers Rubin Ultra HBM Configuration
paras: TrendForce 最新記憶體產業研究，由於 DRAM 供不應求格局將延續至 2027 年，且原廠 HBM4e 的驗證進度存在變數，自今年第三季起，輝達 (NVDA-US) 對 Rubin Ultra 的 HBM 配置已從 HBM4e 12hi，改為並行評估 HBM4e 8hi、HBM4 12hi、HBM4 8hi 等多項設計，目前尚未定案。除了輝達外，部分雲端服務供應商 (CSP) 也正考慮調降下一代自研 ASIC 的 HBM 容量設計。
TrendForce 表示，近期記憶體供給緊缺已導致數次 AI 晶片的 DRAM 規格調降。2026 上半年以來，CSP、伺服器 OEM 陸續下調 RDIMM 容量；日前輝達也考量 LPDDR5X 短缺將持續至 2027 年，決定將次世代 Vera Rubin Superchip 模組所搭載的 SOCAMM 容量減半。
針對 Rubin Ultra，輝達在 2025 年至 2026 上半年間皆以 HBM4e 12hi 作為基準設計，直至第三季上旬起開放評估其他較低的規格，目前持續研議中。此舉主要為應對供給端的兩項瓶頸。
首先，2027 年整體 DRAM 供應維持緊缺，將限制原廠可分配給 HBM 的晶圓產能。其次，HBM4e 12hi 的驗證、量產良率提升進程仍存在不確定性。
TrendForce 指出，輝達於 Rubin Ultra 世代的主要目標為 I/O speed 的提升，而次要目標為追求 GPU 出貨規模成長。若最終決定調降 HBM 規格，預期將傾向從調整堆疊層數 (DRAM stack layers) 著手。
總結而言，HBM4e 能否如期完成驗證與量產，將決定 Rubin Ultra 的 I/O speed 可否從前一代 Rubin 的 8 至 11.7Gbps 升級至 14 至 16Gbps，抑或僅能藉 HBM4 設計優化改善至 11 至 12Gbps。另一方面，在既定世代下，堆疊層數將決定單顆 GPU 的 HBM 搭載容量與可出貨 GPU 顆數之間的分配權衡。

TrendForce 認為，後續規格定案亦將取決於原廠晶圓供給分配。就供需而言，預估 2027 年 HBM 出貨位元將年增 50-60%，仍不足以支應需求端的成長。在供不應求格局的情況下，TrendForce 預期 2027 年 HBM 議價權仍偏向供應商，HBM 單位價格大幅上漲已成為產業共識。AI 晶片廠商將面臨 HBM 供給量緊縮與採購成本提高的雙重壓力，採用較低容量 HBM 的動機隨之增強。
paras_en: TrendForce’s latest memory industry research indicates that the DRAM shortage will persist through 2027, and the verification progress of manufacturers’ HBM4e remains uncertain. Starting in Q3 of this year, Nvidia (NVDA-US) has changed the HBM configuration for Rubin Ultra from HBM4e 12‑hi to a parallel evaluation of several designs, including HBM4e 8‑hi, HBM4 12‑hi and HBM4 8‑hi, none of which have been finalized yet. In addition to Nvidia, some cloud service providers (CSPs) are also considering reducing the HBM capacity design for their next‑generation in‑house ASICs.

In recent weeks, the tight memory supply has already forced several AI chips to downgrade their DRAM specifications. Since the first half of 2026, CSPs and server OEMs have been gradually lowering RDIMM capacities; Nvidia, noting that LPDDR5X shortages will continue into 2027, has decided to halve the SOCAMM capacity used in the next‑generation Vera Rubin Superchip module.

For Rubin Ultra, Nvidia used HBM4e 12‑hi as the baseline design throughout 2025 and the first half of 2026. Beginning in early Q3, the company opened an evaluation of lower‑spec options and is still studying the matter. The move is intended to address two supply‑side bottlenecks.

First, overall DRAM supply will remain tight in 2027, limiting the wafer capacity that manufacturers can allocate to HBM. Second, the verification and yield‑improvement timeline for HBM4e 12‑hi remains uncertain.

TrendForce notes that the primary goal for the Rubin Ultra generation is to boost I/O speed, while the secondary goal is to drive GPU shipment growth. If the HBM specification is ultimately lowered, the adjustment is expected to start with the number of stack layers (DRAM stack layers).

In summary, whether HBM4e can complete verification and mass production on schedule will determine if Rubin Ultra’s I/O speed can be upgraded from the previous Rubin’s 8‑11.7 Gbps to 14‑16 Gbps, or only improve to 11‑12 Gbps through HBM4 design optimizations. Meanwhile, within the defined generation, the stack layer count will dictate the trade‑off between HBM capacity per GPU and the number of GPUs that can be shipped.

TrendForce believes that the final specification will also depend on how manufacturers allocate wafer supply. From a supply‑demand perspective, HBM shipments are projected to grow 50‑60% year‑over‑year in 2027, still insufficient to meet demand growth. In a shortage environment, TrendForce expects HBM pricing power to remain with suppliers in 2027, and a sharp rise in HBM unit prices has become industry consensus. AI chip makers will face dual pressure from tighter HBM supply and higher procurement costs, increasing the incentive to adopt lower‑capacity HBM.

items.title: 美銀點名買入這「9檔」AI半導體股！最高潛在漲幅88%、雲端資本支出上看1.2兆美元
items.title_en: Bank of America Names 9 AI Semiconductor Stocks with Up to 88% Upside, Cloud Capital Spending to Reach $1.2 Trillion
paras: 儘管七月半導體類股遭遇賣壓，市場擔憂大型科技業者放緩人工智慧（AI）支出腳步會衝擊股市，但最新數據顯示，情勢正朝反方向發展。為此美銀也點名九支半導體股，認為其 12 個月目標價位有約 30 到 90％的上漲空間，並給予它們「買入」評級。
根據《TradingView》報導，科技巨頭的資本支出似乎沒有放緩的跡象。美國銀行 (BAC-US) 半導體分析師 Vivek Arya 就指出，未來十二個月，主要雲端服務業者的資本支出總額可望突破 1.2 兆美元。
今年夏天早些時候，市場預計美國五大超大規模資料中心營運商在 2026 年的支出約為 7,000 億美元。
Arya 於週一（3 日）表示：「雲端業者的投資意願依然強勁」，顯示 AI 基礎建設熱潮不僅持續時間超乎預期，投入資金規模也持續加碼。

科技巨頭燒錢，晶片供應商卻受惠

報導指出，AI 經濟體系內部正出現一種特殊的資源重分配現象。對雲端業者而言，基礎建設競賽成本節節攀升；但對供應鏈上游廠商來說，這些支出正是營收來源。
以微軟 (MSFT-US) 為例，其資本支出年增率一度高達 63%，自由現金流卻同期下滑 10%，資本支出佔營運現金流比重更逼近 100%，成為投資人質疑 AI 建設經濟效益的主因。
然而，站在天秤另一端的晶片供應商卻穩收其利。分析稱，雲端業者每多投入一美元建設 AI 資料中心，就代表對 GPU、客製化加速晶片、記憶體、網路設備與晶圓製造產能的需求隨之增加。
華爾街其他機構的預測也得出相同結論。摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 近日預估，超大規模雲端服務商的資本支出將在 2026 年達約 8,000 億美元，2027 年進一步攀升至 1.2 兆美元，遠高於該行一年前預估的約 4,500 億美元。
換言之，市場瓶頸正從「需求不足」轉為「供給跟不上」，這項轉變意義重大，若雲端業者支出持續走高，近期的半導體股修正就不再是 AI 循環告終的訊號，而更像是這波投資熱潮中的一次估值重整。

九檔潛在漲幅近 30％的半導體股

有鑑於此，美銀將受惠標的分為運算、記憶體、半導體設備、電源半導體及光學元件五大類別。
根據美銀最新目標價，以下九檔個股（依 8 月 3 日收盤價計算）有約 30 到 90％的潛在漲幅：

邁威爾科技 (MRVL-US) ：目標價 365 美元，潛在漲幅 88%
 美光科技 (MU-US) ：目標價 1550 美元，潛在漲幅 87%
 英特爾 (INTC-US) ：目標價 160 美元，潛在漲幅 76%
 輝達 (NVDA-US) ：目標價 350 美元，潛在漲幅 69%
Credo Technology (CRDO-US) ：目標價 340 美元，潛在漲幅 56%
 科磊 (KLAC-US) ：目標價 260 美元，潛在漲幅 42%
 應用材料 (AMAT-US) ：目標價 720 美元，潛在漲幅 39%
 博通 (AVGO-US) ：目標價 530 美元，潛在漲幅 35%
 超微半導體 (AMD-US) ：目標價 620 美元，潛在漲幅 28%


值得注意的是，這份名單橫跨 AI 基礎建設供應鏈的各個關鍵環節。
輝達與超微半導體提供加速運算晶片；博通與邁威爾科技則同時涉足客製化晶片與網路連結領域；Credo 專攻連結技術；美光供應維持運算晶片運作所需的記憶體；科磊與應用材料則位處更上游，銷售用於製造高複雜度晶片的設備。
這種廣泛的產業覆蓋面意義重大，代表這波投資邏輯已不再仰賴單一晶片廠商獨佔 AI 商機，而是取決於建構 AI 基礎建設本身所涉及的實體複雜度。

「供不應求」正成為新投資主軸

分析稱，記憶體市場堪稱最鮮明的案例。美光股價今年已因 AI 需求與供給緊縮相互激盪而大幅重新評價，記憶體循環也成為今年半導體類股中最強勁的交易題材之一。
連結技術領域也出現類似走勢。根據美銀先前研究，Credo 在主動式電纜市場的市佔率高達約 75%，該市場規模預估將由今年約 12 億美元，成長至 2030 年逾 70 億美元。
類似機制亦不斷在 AI 供應鏈中重演。雲端業者對運算力的渴求，速度總是超越供應商所能提供的產能，而這種「供不應求」的效應正持續擴散：

加速晶片需求增加，連帶推升記憶體需求；
伺服器數量增加，帶動更快速網路設備需求；
晶片複雜度提升，也需要更多晶圓製造與測試設備支援。


甚至運算密度的提升，也正在電力與散熱基礎建設領域創造出「次級商機」，例如液冷技術的轉型浪潮，已為資料中心散熱供應鏈帶來更龐大的訂單量。
因此，1.2 兆美元這個數字的意義，與其說是一項預測，不如說是當前 AI 投資循環所處階段的具體證據。
近期半導體股修正期間，市場多半聚焦於「科技巨頭是否已經燒錢過頭」的疑慮；但美國銀行最新的預估數據顯示，投資人或許很快就得面對截然相反的課題，即雲端業者的建設速度終究可能仍追不上需求。
paras_en: Despite the sell-off in semiconductor stocks in July, with the market worried that big tech companies would slow down their artificial intelligence (AI) spending, the latest data shows that the situation is moving in the opposite direction. As a result, Bank of America has named nine semiconductor stocks that it believes have a 30-90% upside potential over the next 12 months, giving them a 'buy' rating.

According to a report by TradingView, the capital spending of tech giants shows no signs of slowing down. Vivek Arya, a semiconductor analyst at Bank of America, pointed out that the total capital spending of major cloud service providers is expected to exceed $1.2 trillion over the next 12 months.

Earlier in the summer, the market had expected the top five hyperscale data center operators in the US to spend around $700 billion in 2026. However, Arya stated on Monday that 'the willingness to invest in cloud services remains strong', indicating that the AI infrastructure boom is not only lasting longer than expected but also increasing in scale.

The report notes that a special phenomenon of resource reallocation is occurring within the AI economy. For cloud service providers, the cost of infrastructure competition is rising, but for upstream manufacturers in the supply chain, these expenditures are a source of revenue.

Taking Microsoft (MSFT-US) as an example, its capital spending growth rate once reached 63%, while its free cash flow fell by 10% over the same period, and the proportion of capital spending to operating cash flow approached 100%, becoming a major reason for investors to question the economic benefits of AI construction.

However, chip suppliers are benefiting from this trend. Analysts say that for every dollar that cloud service providers invest in building AI data centers, the demand for GPUs, customized acceleration chips, memory, network equipment, and wafer manufacturing capacity increases.

Other institutions on Wall Street have also come to the same conclusion. Morgan Stanley (MS-US) recently estimated that the capital spending of hyperscale cloud service providers will reach around $800 billion in 2026 and further increase to $1.2 trillion in 2027, far exceeding the bank's estimate of around $450 billion a year ago.

In other words, the market bottleneck is shifting from 'lack of demand' to 'inadequate supply', a change that is significant. If cloud service providers' spending continues to rise, the recent correction in semiconductor stocks may not be a sign of the end of the AI cycle, but rather a revaluation in the midst of this investment boom.
